summary_en: 100,000 shares (1.26% of shares outstanding), ¥6.5B upper limit. Acquisition window 1 Sept – 31 Dec 2026. Open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Reason: flexible capital management in response to business environment change.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 28 August 2026, Takahashi Curtain Wall Corporation's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 100,000 of its own ordinary shares (1.26% of shares outstanding, calculated as 100,000 ÷ 7,923,747) via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥6.5 billion. The acquisition window runs from 1 September to 31 December 2026. The company stated that the repurchase is being undertaken to enable flexible capital management in response to changes in the business environment, pursuant to the authority granted under the Company Law Article 165(3) as read with Article 156. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 1,629,264 treasury shares against 7,923,747 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
